episodes.synopsis: Dan and the gang have set up a new arena - but a mysterious brawler from Team Anubias arrives to challenge Dan for the leaderboard.
episodes.title: Interspace Showdown

episodes.synopsis: Dan denies there's a problem with Drago and in private he takes him to an abandoned arena to practise. However, a powerful Bakugan appears from nowhere to battle.
episodes.title: Mechtogan Mayhem

episodes.synopsis: Dan is struggling to comprehend that Code Eve is the source of Drago's evil power. He then gets drawn into an argument with Annubius and agrees to a match.
episodes.title: Disconnect

episodes.synopsis: Dan's mum tells Shun and Marucho that he's been having nightmares, they follow Dan to find out that he's been training Drago in secret.
episodes.title: Fall From Grace

episodes.synopsis: The team ask Dan to take a break from battling until he can learn to harness Drago's new powers. However, life without Dan is harder than they thought.
episodes.title: Tri-Twister Take Down

episodes.synopsis: Dan is haunted by strange dreams as he attempts to get back to battling and harness Drago's powers yet his new abilities once again prove too powerful for him.
episodes.title: Agony of Defeat

episodes.synopsis: The newly discovered Bako-Nanos allow the brawlers to engage in more extreme battling. Meanwhile, the Bash Bros take the tournament by storm.
episodes.title: BakuNano Explosion

episodes.synopsis: Dan and Drago return to new Vestroia to train. They run into Prayus and his new student Amazon, however, even in practise Drago cannot control his powers.
episodes.title: Return to New Vestroia

episodes.synopsis: Anubias is sent to New Vestroia to battle Dan and Drago. Preyas steps in, but Anubias summons his own Mechtogan.
episodes.title: Chaos Control

episodes.synopsis: Rafe and Paige learned that the Mechtogans appears when there is a lack of sync between a brawler and their Bakugan. Meanwhile, Marucho's father asks him to quit.
episodes.title: A Royale Pain

episodes.synopsis: Drago struggles to gain control of Zenthon and worries that it is because he and Dan are out of sync; Paige and Rafe worry that the Brawlers are slipping.
episodes.title: Back in Sync

episodes.synopsis: Wyvern takes Dan and Drago on a journey into the center of their minds to try and solve the identity of the mysterious man haunting their visions.
episodes.title: Mind Search

episodes.synopsis: In order to save Drago's powers, Dan and Drago have to go back through their own memories to find Code Eve, the mother of all Bakugan.
episodes.title: Re-Connection

episodes.synopsis: The Brawlers face Team Anubias in the next round and Dan and Drago have to summon a Mechtogan Titanin order to defeat Sellon's triple Mechtogan assault.
episodes.title: Triple Threat

episodes.synopsis: With the Chaos Bakugan on a deadly rampage, the Bakugan Battle Brawlers must try to save the day by summoning their Bakugan to do battle.
episodes.title: Interspace Under Siege

episodes.synopsis: Dan Kuso expected a Hero's welcome on his return, but he soon finds that people are still angry at him for leaving.
episodes.title: A Hero Returns

episodes.synopsis: The Battle Brawlers go to Paige's home and find a devastated city, discovering later that the evil Mag Mel and the brutish Razenoid are behind it all.
episodes.title: Gundalia Under Fire

episodes.synopsis: The Gundalian soldiers try to get revenge on the Chaos Bakugan but Anubias and Sellon's powerful bakugans, Aquos-Darkus and Pyrus-Darkus, soon arrive.
episodes.title: Battle Lines

episodes.synopsis: Nurzak warns the others that the Chaos Bakugan's next target will be Neathia - if they are able to take Gundalia down.
episodes.title: Unlocking the Gate

episodes.synopsis: After the Gundalias battle, Mag Mel desires Dan's key even more so he sends Anubias and Sellon to get it, but they also aspire to destroy Dan on.
episodes.title: True Colours

episodes.synopsis: Spyron hunts Sellon down but Chris and Soon save her and take her with them to the repaired access point, but will she help or just cause trouble?
episodes.title: Dangerous Beauty

episodes.synopsis: Dan and Shun are defending Bakugan Interspace when they discover Mag Mel has both the gate and the key, meaning his resurrection is not far away.
episodes.title: Unfinished Business

episodes.synopsis: Stuck in Interspace, battling off the Chaos Bakugan, Dan has a vision that Mag Mel plans to attack the Earth but will he be successful?
episodes.title: Behind the Mask

episodes.synopsis: Marucho explains the plan to prevent Mag Mel from getting to Earth but, before that, they must split into two groups.
episodes.title: Interspace Armageddon

episodes.synopsis: Mag Mel tortures all the humans by putting them into the dark reverse dimension of the Earth while the Dark Moon sends Razen Titans to blow the Earth up.
episodes.title: Dark Moon

episodes.synopsis: The battle continues between Dan and Mag Mel and, with the team fighting Bakugan, Mechtogan and Mechtogan Titans on Earth, will this be the end of it all?
episodes.title: The Final Takedown

episodes.synopsis: A long time has passed since Mag Mel and Razenoid's defeat. Earth, New Vestroia, Vestal, and Neathia have been emptied of all the Chaos Bakugan. Everyone has returned home, including Spectra, Gus, Paige, Rafe, Taylean, and Trister.
episodes.title: Evil Arrival

episodes.synopsis: The Brawlers learn that the leader of the Mechtogan's and Nonet Bakugan is a battler called Wiseman.
episodes.title: Wiseman Cometh

episodes.synopsis: Dan, Drago, and Reptak ask the people of Bakugan City if they have seen Gunz, but no one has. Then Reptak, Gunz's former Bakugan partner, hears Gunz's voice and joins Dan and Drago in the battle against Wiseman.
episodes.title: Mysterious Bond

episodes.synopsis: After Shun and Jaakor train together, Shun takes off but Orbeum and Skytruss appear and ask Jaakor to go with them to New Vestroia to protect the Bakugan. Meanwhile, Shun is confronted by Wiseman and his Bakugan Spatterix and Stronk.
episodes.title: Prodigal Bakugan

episodes.synopsis: Dan, Drago, and Reptak ask the people of Bakugan City if they have seen Gunz, but no one has. Then Reptak, Gunz's former Bakugan partner, hears Gunz's voice and joins Dan and Drago in the battle against Wiseman.
episodes.title: Combination Impossible

episodes.synopsis: A friend from the past comes to help the Brawlers in a battle with Wiseman and his Mechtogan.
episodes.title: Enemy Allies

episodes.synopsis: Wiseman reappears and attacks the amusement park that Bakugan helped create Bakugan Land. Julie decides to go and confront him as a reporter to see what his problem is, and the Battle Brawlers must try and find a way to contain the Nomads powers once again.
episodes.title: Battle for Bakugan Land

episodes.synopsis: Gunz suddenly appears after a long absence. Dan is suspicious that Gunz and Wiseman are one in the same.
episodes.title: Gunz Blazing

episodes.synopsis: Now that Wiseman has stolen several of their Battle Suits, the Brawlers lure Wiseman into a battle in attempt to take them back.
episodes.title: Battle Suit Bash

episodes.synopsis: The Brawlers go on the hunt to track down any clues that might lead them to Wiseman's hideout in an effort to trap him there.
episodes.title: Countdown to Doomsday

episodes.synopsis: It's a race against time as the Brawlers once again battle Mechtavius Destroyer, but this time they are missing a crucial member.
episodes.title: The Eve of Extermination

episodes.synopsis: Runo meets a new Bakugan named Aerogan, who asks to be her partner. Aerogan must prove himself against Wiseman and his henchmen.
episodes.title: Jump to Victory

episodes.synopsis: When the Brawlers are finally able to infiltrate Wiseman's stronghold, they are drawn into a vicious battle.
episodes.title: Enemy Infiltration

episodes.synopsis: Gunz discovers that Wiseman has morphed and taken on his features! Wiseman finally reveals his dark secret.
episodes.title: Gunz Lives

episodes.synopsis: Coredegon and his Mechtogan brothers combine to make Mechtavius Destroyer, a powerful mega-Mechtogan who wants to conquer the earth and universe.
episodes.title: Evil Evolution

episodes.synopsis: The Brawlers are trapped in the Doom Dimension by Mechtogan Mechtavius Destroyer. Meanwhile, The Nonet Bakugan take on Mechtavius Destroyer.
episodes.title: Evil vs. Evil

episodes.synopsis: Mechtavius Destroyer wreaks havoc in Bakugan City. The Brawlers, still trapped in the Doom Dimension, battle Gunz and Betadron.
episodes.title: Doom Dimension Throwdown

episodes.synopsis: After attacking Bakugan City, Mechtavius Destroyer invades New Vestroia. The Bakugan put up a brave fight but are no match for his strength.
episodes.title: Blast from the Past

episodes.synopsis: The Brawlers travel back in time with the help of Professor Worton in an attempt to undo the destruction caused by Mechtavius Destroyer.
episodes.title: Beginning of the End

episodes.synopsis: As the Brawlers face off against Mechtavius Destroyer in the battle to end all battles, Dragonoid Destroyer pulls a surprise maneuver.
episodes.title: The End of the Line
